name: The Blueberry Farm Livingston
tagline: The Blueberry Farm in East Texas
description: The Blueberry Farm Livingston grows Blueberries in Livingston, TX. The farm is family-run, and its seasons run through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
